Title: GrapheneOS (@GrapheneOS@grapheneos.social)
Description:
@maya@gs.lexinova.eu @OmegaPolice@hachyderm.io @britter@chaos.social Most banking apps work on GrapheneOS but many have memory corruption bugs and incorrect anti-tampering code requiring our per-app exploit protection compatibility mode toggle.

Around 10% of banking apps are unavailable due to banning using a non-Google-approved OS. Around a dozen banking apps began specifically permitting GrapheneOS in addition to a Google-approved OS which is growing.

There's a good list based on ongoing user reports:

Title: The glorious @xkcdRandom Zig builtin
Description: One of my favorite xkcd comics of all time is Random Number. The image depicts a C function that supposedly returns a random integer, but in reality always returns 4. I was reminded of this wonderful comic a few days ago, due to a security incident where people accidentally used the number 4 (among others) instead of a properly generated sequence of random bytes. Satire has a tendency to become reality, I guess.
